overview_markdown:
## Overview

n8nClaw is a lightweight reimagining of OpenClaw built entirely as an [n8n](https://n8n.io) visual workflow rather than a traditional codebase. It wires together Telegram, WhatsApp (via Evolution API), Gmail, and an hourly heartbeat trigger into a central AI agent powered by Claude Sonnet 4.5 through OpenRouter, with Postgres-backed chat memory (15-message window) and a configurable 'soul' personality field.

The architecture includes tiered sub-agents (research, email, document management, generic workers), task and subtask databases, and a scheduled memory pipeline that aggregates chat history, summarizes it with Haiku 4.5, embeds it via OpenAI, and stores it in a Supabase vector database for RAG. This gives it persistent long-term memory and autonomous task processing similar in spirit to OpenClaw.

The key trade-off versus OpenClaw is approachability versus robustness: everything is editable in n8n's drag-and-drop canvas, but the project depends on a stack of external services (n8n, Postgres, Supabase, OpenRouter, Evolution API), has no releases or tests, and consists of only initial commits. It is best viewed as an interesting starter template for no-code builders rather than a mature OpenClaw alternative.
